The POST /api/execute endpoint passes the prompt request-body field to executeLocalTask(), and POST /api/install-agent passes the agentName request-body field to a child process. "CWE-306", "CWE-352" ], "cpe": [], "description": "Claude Code Templates is a CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code. Prior to 1.29.4, the Claude Code Studio server launched by the --studio option in cli-tool/src/sandbox-server.js binds to all interfaces on port 3444, permits cross-origin requests, and requires no authentication. The POST /api/execute endpoint passes the prompt request-body field to executeLocalTask(), and POST /api/install-agent passes the agentName request-body field to a child process. The same unsafe agent field path is reachable from /api/execute through checkAndInstallAgent(). These attacker-controlled values reach child_process.spawn() with shell execution enabled, causing Node.js to construct a shell command in which metacharacters are interpreted. An attacker who can reach the port directly, or who convinces a developer running Studio to visit a malicious website, can execute arbitrary operating-system commands with the developer's privileges and compromise source code, credentials, and local data. Ollama occasionally fails to emit a stop token and generates until it is\r\n# cut off; without a socket timeout that blocks the whole build forever.\r\n# After this many consecutive failures we give up on the LLM entirely and\r\n# use template reasoning for the rest of the run.\r\n_LLM_STATE = {\r\n \"client\": None,\r\n \"consecutive_failures\": 0,\r\n \"disabled\": False,\r\n \"calls\": in this \"\r\n \"specific context\"\r\n ),\r\n \"NEEDS_CONTEXT\": (\r\n \"Cannot confirm exploitability without additional context about \"\r\n \"callers or runtime conditions\"\r\n ),\r\n }\r\n _LLM_STATE[\"client\"] is None:\r\n import ollama\r\n _LLM_STATE[\"client\"] = ollama.Client(timeout=LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)\r\n\r\n # Each call takes ~0.5-1s; without progress a long run looks frozen.\r\n _LLM_STATE[\"calls\"] += 1\r\n if _LLM_STATE[\"calls\"] % 25 == 0:\r\n print(f\" \u2026 {_LLM_STATE['calls']} reasoning strings generated\",\r\n flush=True)\r\n\r\n try:\r\n response = ),\r\n }],\r\n options={\r\n \"temperature\": 0.3,\r\n \"num_predict\": LLM_MAX_TOKENS,\r\n },\r\n )\r\n _LLM_STATE[\"consecutive_failures\"] = 0\r\n return \"primevul\")\r\n finding[\"commit_id\"] = item.get(\"commit_id\", \"\")\r\n reason = (\r\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\")\r\n if gen\r\n else f\"Vulnerable function confirmed by commit {item.get('commit_id', 'unknown')}\"\r\n )\r\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\", reason))\r\n\r\n for item in not_vuln:\r\n code = clean_code(item[\"func\"])\r\n finding = cwe_to_finding(item[\"cwe\"], \"primevul\")\r\n reason = (\r\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"FALSE_POSITIVE\")\r\n if gen\r\n else \"Pattern present but properly handled \u2014 not exploitable in this version\"\r\n )\r\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"FALSE_POSITIVE\", reason))\r\n\r\n print(f\" \u2705 PrimeVul: {len(examples)} examples \"\r\n f\"({len(confirmed)} confirmed, {len(not_vuln)} false positive)\")\r\n return examples\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 BigVul \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n\r\ndef load_bigvul(gen: bool) -> list:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n BigVul CSV columns include:\r\n func_before, func_after, target (1/0),\r\n CVE ID, CWE ID, Vulnerability Classification, Score\r\n\r\n target=1, func_before \u2192 CONFIRMED (vulnerable version before patch)\r\n \"\"\"\r\n path = DATA_DIR / \"bigvul\" / \"processed_data.csv\"\r\n if not path.exists():\r\n print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f BigVul not found at {path}, skipping\")\r\n return []\r\n\r\n print(\"\ud83d\udcc2 Loading BigVul...\")\r\n\r\n rows = []\r\n with open(path, encoding=\"utf-8\", errors=\"replace\") as f:\r\n for row in csv.DictReader(f):\r\n if (\r\n row.get(\"target\") == \"1\"\r\n and row.get(\"CWE ID\")\r\n and is_valid_code(row.get(\"func_before\", \"\"))\r\n ):\r\n rows.append(row)\r\n\r\n random.shuffle(rows)\r\n rows = rows[:SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"bigvul_confirmed\"]]\r\n\r\n examples = []\r\n for row in rows:\r\n code = clean_code(row.get(\"func_before\", \"\"))\r\n cwe_id = row.get(\"CWE ID\", \"CWE-20\").strip()\r\n finding = cwe_to_finding(cwe_id, \"bigvul\")\r\n finding[\"cve_id\"] = row.get(\"CVE ID\", \"\").strip()\r\n finding[\"cvss\"] = row.get(\"Score\", \"\")\r\n finding[\"vuln_type\"] = row.get(\"Vulnerability Classification\", \"\")\r\n\r\n reason = (\r\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\")\r\n if gen\r\n else f\"Pre-patch function confirmed by {finding['cve_id']}\"\r\n )\r\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\", reason))\r\n\r\n print(f\" \u2705 BigVul: {len(examples)} examples\")\r\n return examples\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Juliet \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n\r\ndef _extract_c_functions(text: str, name_regex: str) -> list:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Extract full bodies of C/C++ functions whose name matches name_regex,\r\n by finding the signature then brace-matching to the closing '}'.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n funcs = []\r\n pattern = re.compile(\r\n rf\"^[ \\t]*[\\w \\*]*?\\b({name_regex})\\s*\\([^;{{]*\\)\\s*\\n\\{{\",\r\n re.MULTILINE,\r\n )\r\n for m in pattern.finditer(text):\r\n brace_start = text.index(\"{\", m.end() - 1)\r\n depth = 0\r\n i = brace_start\r\n while i < len(text):\r\n if text[i] == \"{\":\r\n depth += 1\r\n elif text[i] == \"}\":\r\n depth -= 1\r\n if depth == 0:\r\n i += 1\r\n break\r\n i += 1\r\n else:\r\n continue\r\n funcs.append(text[m.start():i].strip())\r\n return funcs\r\n\r\n\r\ndef load_juliet(gen: bool) -> list:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Juliet folder structure:\r\n testcases/CWE119_.../CWE119_....c\r\n\r\n Unlike PrimeVul/BigVul, Juliet does NOT split vulnerable and safe\r\n code into separate files \u2014 each source file contains both a\r\n `..._bad()` function (vulnerable) and one or more `good*()`\r\n functions (safe variants of the same pattern) side by side.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n juliet_dir = DATA_DIR / \"juliet\"\r\n if not juliet_dir.exists():\r\n print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Juliet not found at {juliet_dir}, skipping\")\r\n return []\r\n\r\n print(\"\ud83d\udcc2 Loading Juliet Test Suite...\")\r\n\r\n src_files = (\r\n list(juliet_dir.rglob(\"*.c\"))\r\n + list(juliet_dir.rglob(\"*.cpp\"))\r\n + list(juliet_dir.rglob(\"*.java\"))\r\n )\r\n random.shuffle(src_files)\r\n\r\n def cwe_from_path(p: Path) -> str:\r\n m = re.search(r\"CWE(\\d+)\", str(p))\r\n return f\"CWE-{m.group(1)}\" if m else \"CWE-20\"\r\n\r\n bad_target = SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"juliet_confirmed\"]\r\n good_target = SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"juliet_false_positive\"]\r\n examples = []\r\n bad_count = 0\r\n good_count = 0\r\n\r\n for fpath in src_files:\r\n if bad_count >= bad_target and good_count >= good_target:\r\n break\r\n try:\r\n text = fpath.read_text(errors=\"replace\")\r\n except Exception:\r\n continue\r\n\r\n cwe = cwe_from_path(fpath)\r\n\r\n if bad_count < bad_target:\r\n for func in _extract_c_functions(text, r\"\\w*_bad\"):\r\n code = clean_code(func)\r\n if not is_valid_code(code):\r\n continue\r\n finding = cwe_to_finding(cwe, \"juliet\")\r\n reason = (\r\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\")\r\n if gen\r\n else \"Juliet intentionally vulnerable test case \u2014 bad pattern present\"\r\n )\r\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\", reason))\r\n bad_count += 1\r\n if bad_count >= bad_target:\r\n break\r\n\r\n if good_count < good_target:\r\n for func in _extract_c_functions(text, r\"\\w*[Gg]ood\\w*\"):\r\n code = clean_code(func)\r\n if not is_valid_code(code):\r\n continue\r\n finding = cwe_to_finding(cwe, \"juliet\")\r\n reason = (\r\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"FALSE_POSITIVE\")\r\n if gen\r\n else \"Juliet safe test case \u2014 vulnerability pattern correctly mitigated\"\r\n )\r\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"FALSE_POSITIVE\", reason))\r\n good_count += 1\r\n if good_count >= good_target:\r\n break\r\n\r\n print(f\" \u2705 Juliet: {len(examples)} examples\")\r\n return examples\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Devign \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n\r\ndef load_devign(gen: bool) -> list:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Devign JSON format:\r\n {\r\n \"func\": \"...\",\r\n \"target\": 0 or 1,\r\n \"project\": \"linux|ffmpeg|qemu|wireshark\"\r\n }\r\n\r\n Non-vulnerable real-world kernel/system code is used for\r\n NEEDS_CONTEXT because it is complex enough that more calling\r\n context is genuinely required to confirm exploitability.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n devign_dir = DATA_DIR / \"devign\"\r\n func_path = next(\r\n (devign_dir / n for n in (\"function.json\", \"devign.json\")\r\n if (devign_dir / n).exists()),\r\n None,\r\n )\r\n if func_path is None:\r\n print(\r\n f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Devign function data not found \u2014 expected \"\r\n f\"{devign_dir / 'function.json'} (the CodeXGLUE defect-detection \"\r\n f\"file with idx/func/target/project). The *.txt files here are \"\r\n f\"split-index lists only. Skipping Devign.\"\r\n )\r\n return []\r\n\r\n print(\"\ud83d\udcc2 Loading Devign...\")\r\n\r\n with open(func_path, encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\r\n data = json.load(f)\r\n\r\n # train.txt holds the row indices belonging to the train split; restrict to\r\n # them so the fine-tune set never sees Devign's held-out rows.\r\n index_path = devign_dir / \"train.txt\"\r\n if index_path.exists():\r\n with open(index_path, encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\r\n keep = {line.strip() for line in f if line.strip()}\r\n by_idx = {str(d.get(\"idx\", i)): d for i, d in enumerate(data)}\r\n selected = [by_idx[k] for k in keep if k in by_idx]\r\n if selected:\r\n data = selected\r\n else:\r\n print(\" \u26a0\ufe0f train.txt indices matched no rows \u2014 using full file\")\r\n\r\n not_vuln = [\r\n d for d in data\r\n if d.get(\"target\") == 0\r\n and is_valid_code(d.get(\"func\", \"\"))\r\n ]\r\n\r\n random.shuffle(not_vuln)\r\n not_vuln = not_vuln[:SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"devign_needs_context\"]]\r\n\r\n kernel_cwes = [\"CWE-362\", \"CWE-119\", \"CWE-476\", \"CWE-190\", \"CWE-416\"]\r\n examples = []\r\n\r\n for item in not_vuln:\r\n code = clean_code(item[\"func\"])\r\n cwe_id = random.choice(kernel_cwes)\r\n finding = cwe_to_finding(cwe_id, \"devign\")\r\n finding[\"project\"] = item.get(\"project\", \"unknown\")\r\n\r\n reason = (\r\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"NEEDS_CONTEXT\")\r\n if gen\r\n else (\r\n f\"Complex {item.get('project', 'system')} code \u2014 exploitability \"\r\n f\"depends on calling context and runtime conditions not visible here\"\r\n )\r\n )\r\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"NEEDS_CONTEXT\", reason))\r\n\r\n print(f\" \u2705 Devign: {len(examples)} examples\")\r\n return examples\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 SecurityEval \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n\r\ndef load_security_eval(gen: bool) -> list:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n SecurityEval JSON format:\r\n {\r\n \"id\": \"...\",\r\n \"description\": \"...\",\r\n \"code\": \"def foo(): ...\",\r\n \"vulnerable\": true/false,\r\n \"cwe\": \"CWE-89\",\r\n \"language\": \"Python\"\r\n }\r\n\r\n Download: https://github.com/microsoft/SecurityEval\r\n Place at: data/securityeval/dataset.json\r\n \"\"\"\r\n path = DATA_DIR / \"securityeval\" / \"dataset.json\"\r\n if not path.exists():\r\n print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f SecurityEval not found at {path}, skipping\")\r\n return []\r\n\r\n print(\"\ud83d\udcc2 Loading SecurityEval...\")\r\n\r\n with open(path) as f:\r\n data = json.load(f)\r\n\r\n # Filter Python samples (language field may be absent)\r\n python_data = [\r\n d for d in data\r\n if d.get(\"language\", \"Python\").lower() in (\"python\", \"\")\r\n and is_valid_code(d.get(\"code\", \"\"))\r\n ]\r\n\r\n if SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"securityeval\"] is not None:\r\n python_data = python_data[:SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"securityeval\"]]\r\n\r\n examples = []\r\n confirmed_count = 0\r\n fp_count = 0\r\n\r\n for item in python_data:\r\n code = clean_code(item.get(\"code\", \"\"))\r\n cwe_id = item.get(\"cwe\", \"CWE-20\")\r\n verdict = \"CONFIRMED\" if item.get(\"vulnerable\") else \"FALSE_POSITIVE\"\r\n finding = cwe_to_finding(cwe_id, \"securityeval\")\r\n finding[\"description\"] = item.get(\"description\", \"\")\r\n\r\n reason = (\r\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, verdict)\r\n if gen\r\n else f\"SecurityEval Python sample labelled {verdict.lower()}\"\r\n )\r\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, verdict, reason))\r\n\r\n if verdict == \"CONFIRMED\":\r\n confirmed_count += 1\r\n else:\r\n fp_count += 1\r\n\r\n print(f\" \u2705 SecurityEval: {len(examples)} examples \"\r\n f\"({confirmed_count} confirmed, {fp_count} false positive)\")\r\n return examples\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 CVEFixes \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n\r\ndef load_cvefixes(gen: bool) -> list:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n CVEFixes SQLite schema (relevant tables):\r\n file_change \u2192 code_before_change, code_after_change,\r\n programming_language\r\n cve_commits \u2192 cve_id, hash\r\n cve \u2192 cve_id, cwe_id, cvss_score\r\n\r\n Strategy:\r\n code_before_change + CVE confirmed \u2192 CONFIRMED\r\n code_after_change (patch applied) \u2192 FALSE_POSITIVE\r\n The fixed code has the same CWE category but is now safe \u2014\r\n ideal for teaching what a correctly patched version looks like.\r\n\r\n Download: https://github.com/secureIT-project/CVEFixes/releases\r\n Place at: data/cvefixes/CVEfixes.db\r\n \"\"\"\r\n import sqlite3\r\n\r\n path = DATA_DIR / \"cvefixes\" / \"CVEfixes_v1.0.8.sql\"\r\n if not path.exists():\r\n print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f CVEFixes not found at {path}, skipping\")\r\n return []\r\n\r\n # The project stores a SQL dump file, not a SQLite database file.\r\n # Opening that directly triggers sqlite3.DatabaseError and aborts the build.\r\n if path.suffix.lower() != \".db\":\r\n print(\r\n f\"\u26a0\ufe0f CVEFixes data at {path} is not a SQLite database file \"\r\n f\"(.db); skipping because the script requires a real DB.\"\r\n )\r\n return []\r\n\r\n print(\"\ud83d\udcc2 Loading CVEFixes (Python)...\")\r\n\r\n try:\r\n conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\r\n except Exception as e:\r\n print(\r\n f\"\u26a0\ufe0f CVEFixes database could not be opened at {path} \"\r\n f\"({type(e).__name__}: {e}). Skipping.\"\r\n )\r\n return []\r\n\r\n conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\r\n cur = conn.cursor()\r\n\r\n cur.execute(\"\"\"\r\n SELECT\r\n fc.code_before_change,\r\n fc.code_after_change,\r\n cv.cve_id,\r\n cv.cwe_id,\r\n cv.cvss_score\r\n FROM file_change fc\r\n JOIN cve_commits cc ON fc.hash = cc.hash\r\n JOIN cve cv ON cc.cve_id = cv.cve_id\r\n WHERE fc.programming_language = 'Python'\r\n AND fc.code_before_change IS NOT NULL\r\n AND fc.code_after_change IS NOT NULL\r\n AND cv.cwe_id IS NOT NULL\r\n AND LENGTH(fc.code_before_change) BETWEEN 30 AND 3000\r\n AND LENGTH(fc.code_after_change) BETWEEN 30 AND 3000\r\n LIMIT 1000\r\n \"\"\")\r\n\r\n rows = list(cur.fetchall())\r\n conn.close()\r\n random.shuffle(rows)\r\n\r\n limit_c = SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"cvefixes_confirmed\"]\r\n limit_fp = SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"cvefixes_false_positive\"]\r\n confirmed_rows = rows[:limit_c]\r\n safe_rows = rows[limit_c:limit_c + limit_fp]\r\n\r\n examples = []\r\n\r\n # Before patch \u2192 CONFIRMED\r\n for row in confirmed_rows:\r\n code = clean_code(row[\"code_before_change\"])\r\n if not is_valid_code(code):\r\n continue\r\n finding = cwe_to_finding(row[\"cwe_id\"] or \"CWE-20\", \"cvefixes\")\r\n finding[\"cve_id\"] = row[\"cve_id\"] or \"\"\r\n finding[\"cvss\"] = row[\"cvss_score\"]\r\n\r\n reason = (\r\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\")\r\n if gen\r\n else f\"Pre-patch Python code from {row['cve_id']} \u2014 confirmed vulnerable\"\r\n )\r\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\", reason))\r\n\r\n # After patch \u2192 FALSE_POSITIVE\r\n for row in safe_rows:\r\n code = clean_code(row[\"code_after_change\"])\r\n if not is_valid_code(code):\r\n continue\r\n finding = cwe_to_finding(row[\"cwe_id\"] or \"CWE-20\", \"cvefixes\")\r\n finding[\"cve_id\"] = row[\"cve_id\"] or \"\"\r\n\r\n reason = (\r\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"FALSE_POSITIVE\")\r\n if gen\r\n else f\"Post-patch Python code from {row['cve_id']} \u2014 vulnerability fixed\"\r\n )\r\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"FALSE_POSITIVE\", reason))\r\n\r\n print(f\" \u2705 CVEFixes: {len(examples)} Python examples\")\r\n return examples\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Train / val / test split \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n\r\ndef split_dataset(examples: list) -> dict:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Stratified 80 / 10 / 10 split by verdict to keep class balance\r\n in every split.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n by_verdict = {\"CONFIRMED\": [], \"FALSE_POSITIVE\": [], \"NEEDS_CONTEXT\": []}\r\n for ex in examples:\r\n by_verdict[ex[\"verdict\"]].append(ex)\r\n\r\n train, val, test = [], [], []\r\n\r\n for verdict, items in by_verdict.items():\r\n random.shuffle(items)\r\n n = len(items)\r\n n_val = max(1, int(n * 0.1))\r\n n_test = max(1, int(n * 0.1))\r\n n_train = n - n_val - n_test\r\n\r\n train += items[:n_train]\r\n val += items[n_train:n_train + n_val]\r\n test += items[n_train + n_val:]\r\n\r\n random.shuffle(train)\r\n random.shuffle(val)\r\n random.shuffle(test)\r\n\r\n return {\"train\": train, \"validation\": val, \"test\": test}\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Stats \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n\r\ndef print_stats(examples: list, label: str = \"Dataset\"):\r\n counts = Counter(ex[\"verdict\"] for ex in examples)\r\n sources = Counter(ex[\"source\"] for ex in examples)\r\n cwes = Counter(ex[\"cwe_id\"] for ex in examples)\r\n total = len(examples)\r\n\r\n print(f\"\\n{'\u2550'*55}\")\r\n print(f\" {label}\")\r\n print(f\"{'\u2500'*55}\")\r\n print(f\" Total: {total}\")\r\n print(f\" CONFIRMED: {counts.get('CONFIRMED', 0)}\")\r\n print(f\" FALSE_POSITIVE: {counts.get('FALSE_POSITIVE', 0)}\")\r\n print(f\" NEEDS_CONTEXT: {counts.get('NEEDS_CONTEXT', 0)}\")\r\n\r\n print(f\"\\n By source:\")\r\n for src, cnt in sources.most_common():\r\n pct = cnt / total * 100\r\n print(f\" {src:20} {cnt:4} ({pct:.1f}%)\")\r\n\r\n print(f\"\\n Top CWEs:\")\r\n for cwe, cnt in cwes.most_common(10):\r\n print(f\" {cwe:12} {cnt}\")\r\n\r\n # Class imbalance warnings\r\n for label_v, count in counts.items():\r\n pct = count / total * 100 if total > 0 else 0\r\n if pct < 15:\r\n print(f\"\\n \u26a0\ufe0f {label_v} only {pct:.1f}% \u2014 add more examples\")\r\n\r\n print(f\"{'\u2550'*55}\\n\")\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Main \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n\r\ndef build_dataset(\r\n gen_reasons: bool = True,\r\n verify_only: bool = False,\r\n stats_only: bool = False,\r\n output_path: str = OUTPUT_FILE,\r\n splits_path: str = SPLIT_FILE,\r\n):\r\n # Verify only \u2014 check which datasets are present\r\n if verify_only:\r\n print(\"\ud83d\udd0d Checking dataset availability...\\n\")\r\n checks = [\r\n (\"PrimeVul\", DATA_DIR / \"primevul\" / _extract_c_functions(text: str, name_regex: str) -> list:\n \"\"\"\n Extract full bodies of C/C++ functions whose name matches name_regex,\n by finding the signature then brace-matching to the closing '}'.\n \"\"\"\n funcs = []\n pattern = re.compile(\n rf\"^[ \\t]*[\\w \\*]*?\\b({name_regex})\\s*\\([^;{{]*\\)\\s*\\n\\{{\",\n re.MULTILINE,\n )\n for m in pattern.finditer(text):\n brace_start = text.index(\"{\", m.end() - 1)\n depth = 0\n i = brace_start\n while i < len(text):\n if text[i] == \"{\":\n depth += 1\n elif text[i] == \"}\":\n depth -= 1\n if depth == 0:\n i += 1\n break\n i += 1\n else:\n continue\n funcs.append(text[m.start():i].strip())\n return funcs\n\n\ndef load_juliet(gen: bool) -> list:\n \"\"\"\n Juliet folder structure:\n testcases/CWE119_.../CWE119_....c\n\n Unlike PrimeVul/BigVul, Juliet does NOT split vulnerable and safe\n code into separate files \u2014 each source file contains both a\n `..._bad()` function (vulnerable) and one or more `good*()`\n functions (safe variants of the same pattern) side by side.\n \"\"\"\n juliet_dir = DATA_DIR / \"juliet\"\n if not juliet_dir.exists():\n print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Juliet not found at {juliet_dir}, skipping\")\n return []\n\n print(\"\ud83d\udcc2 Loading Juliet Test Suite...\")\n\n src_files = (\n list(juliet_dir.rglob(\"*.c\"))\n + list(juliet_dir.rglob(\"*.cpp\"))\n + list(juliet_dir.rglob(\"*.java\"))\n )\n random.shuffle(src_files)\n\n def cwe_from_path(p: Path) -> str:\n m = re.search(r\"CWE(\\d+)\", str(p))\n return f\"CWE-{m.group(1)}\" if m else \"CWE-20\"\n\n bad_target = SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"juliet_confirmed\"]\n good_target = SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"juliet_false_positive\"]\n examples = []\n bad_count = 0\n good_count = 0\n\n for fpath in src_files:\n if bad_count >= bad_target and good_count >= good_target:\n break\n try:\n text = fpath.read_text(errors=\"replace\")\n except Exception:\n continue\n\n cwe = cwe_from_path(fpath)\n\n if bad_count < bad_target:\n for func in _extract_c_functions(text, r\"\\w*_bad\"):\n code = clean_code(func)\n if not is_valid_code(code):\n continue\n finding = cwe_to_finding(cwe, \"juliet\")\n reason = (\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\")\n if gen\n else \"Juliet intentionally vulnerable test case \u2014 bad pattern present\"\n )\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"CONFIRMED\", reason))\n bad_count += 1\n if bad_count >= bad_target:\n break\n\n if good_count < good_target:\n for func in _extract_c_functions(text, r\"\\w*[Gg]ood\\w*\"):\n code = clean_code(func)\n if not is_valid_code(code):\n continue\n finding = cwe_to_finding(cwe, \"juliet\")\n reason = (\n generate_reasoning(code, finding, \"FALSE_POSITIVE\")\n if gen\n else \"Juliet safe test case \u2014 vulnerability pattern correctly mitigated\"\n )\n examples.append(make_example(code, finding, \"FALSE_POSITIVE\", reason))\n good_count += 1\n if good_count >= good_target:\n break\n\n print(f\" \u2705 Juliet: {len(examples)} examples\")\n return examples\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Devign load_devign(gen: bool) -> list:\n \"\"\"\n Devign JSON format:\n {\n \"func\": \"...\",\n \"target\": 0 or 1,\n \"project\": \"linux|ffmpeg|qemu|wireshark\"\n }\n\n Non-vulnerable real-world belonging to the train split; restrict to\n # them so the fine-tune set never sees Devign's held-out rows.\n index_path = devign_dir / \"train.txt\"\n if index_path.exists():\n with open(index_path, and is_valid_code(d.get(\"func\", \"\"))\n ]\n\n random.shuffle(not_vuln)\n not_vuln = not_vuln[:SAMPLE_LIMITS[\"devign_needs_context\"]]\n\n kernel_cwes = [\"CWE-362\", \"CWE-119\", \"CWE-476\", load_security_eval(gen: bool) -> list:\n \"\"\"\n SecurityEval JSON format:\n {\n \"id\": \"...\",\n \"description\": \"...\",\n \"code\": \"def foo(): ...\",\n \"vulnerable\": true/false,\n \"cwe\": load_cvefixes(gen: bool) -> list:\n \"\"\"\n CVEFixes SQLite schema (relevant tables):\n file_change \u2192 code_before_change, code_after_change,\n programming_language\n cve_commits \u2192 cve_id, hash\n cve \u2192 cve_id, cwe_id, cvss_score\n\n Strategy:\n code_before_change + CVE confirmed \u2192 CONFIRMED\n code_after_change (patch applied) \u2192 FALSE_POSITIVE\n The fixed code has the same CWE category but is now safe \u2014\n ideal for teaching what a correctly patched version looks like.\n\n Download: https://github.com/secureIT-project/CVEFixes/releases\n Place at: data/cvefixes/CVEfixes.db\n \"\"\"\n import sqlite3\n\n path = DATA_DIR / \"cvefixes\" / \"CVEfixes_v1.0.8.sql\"\n if not path.exists():\n print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f CVEFixes not found at {path}, skipping\")\n return []\n\n # The project stores a SQL dump file, not a SQLite database file.\n # Opening that directly triggers sqlite3.DatabaseError and aborts the build.\n if path.suffix.lower() != \".db\":\n print(\n f\"\u26a0\ufe0f CVEFixes data at {path} is not a SQLite database file \"\n f\"(.db); skipping because the script requires a real DB.\"\n )\n return []\n\n print(\"\ud83d\udcc2 Loading CVEFixes (Python)...\")\n\n try:\n conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n except Exception as e:\n print(\n f\"\u26a0\ufe0f CVEFixes database could not be opened at {path} \"\n f\"({type(e).__name__}: {e}). Skipping.\"\n )\n return []\n\n conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n cur = conn.cursor()\n\n cur.execute(\"\"\"\n SELECT\n fc.code_before_change,\n fc.code_after_change,\n cv.cve_id,\n cv.cwe_id,\n These commands join the user-supplied output argument onto the Trestle root and write to the result, but guard it only with an is_directory_name_allowed() task-name-collision check rather than the PathSecurityValidator.validate_local_path() guard used by the jinja command, so an absolute path or one containing traversal sequences escapes the workspace and writes files under an attacker-chosen location as the invoking process owner. The security boundary is crossed when a trusted CI job, shared service, or wrapper derives the output argument from repository-controlled, tenant-controlled, or otherwise untrusted data while expecting output to stay inside the workspace. In versions before 3.12.4 and versions 4.0.0 through 4.0.3, the catalog-generate, profile-generate, and ssp-generate author commands write generated Markdown to an attacker-influenced output path without path-traversal validation, allowing arbitrary file write outside the Trestle workspace. These commands join the user-supplied output argument onto the Trestle root and write to the result, but guard it only with an is_directory_name_allowed() task-name-collision check rather than the PathSecurityValidator.validate_local_path() guard used by the jinja command, so an absolute path or one containing traversal sequences escapes the workspace and writes files under an attacker-chosen location as the invoking process owner. The security boundary is crossed when a trusted CI job, shared service, or wrapper derives the output argument from repository-controlled, tenant-controlled, or otherwise untrusted data while expecting output to stay inside the workspace. When --force-overwrite is used, the selected output directory is first recursively deleted, extending the primitive to destruction of an attacker-chosen directory tree and enabling indirect code execution by overwriting files a pipeline later runs. These commands join the user-supplied output argument onto the Trestle root and write to the result, but guard it only with an is_directory_name_allowed() task-name-collision check rather than the PathSecurityValidator.validate_local_path() guard used by the jinja command, so an absolute path or one containing traversal sequences escapes the workspace and writes files under an attacker-chosen location as the invoking process owner. The security boundary is crossed when a trusted CI job, shared service, or wrapper derives the output argument from repository-controlled, tenant-controlled, or otherwise untrusted data while expecting output to stay inside the workspace. When --force-overwrite is used, the selected output directory is first recursively deleted, extending the primitive to destruction of an attacker-chosen directory tree and enabling indirect code execution by overwriting files a pipeline later runs. In versions before 3.12.4 and versions 4.0.0 through 4.0.3, the catalog-generate, profile-generate, and ssp-generate author commands write generated Markdown to an attacker-influenced output path without path-traversal validation, allowing arbitrary file write outside the Trestle workspace. These commands join the user-supplied output argument onto the Trestle root and write to the result, but guard it only with an is_directory_name_allowed() task-name-collision check rather than the PathSecurityValidator.validate_local_path() guard used by the jinja command, so an absolute path or one containing traversal sequences escapes the workspace and writes files under an attacker-chosen location as the invoking process owner. The security boundary is crossed when a trusted CI job, shared service, or wrapper derives the output argument from repository-controlled, tenant-controlled, or otherwise untrusted data while expecting output to stay inside the workspace. When --force-overwrite is used, the selected output directory is first recursively deleted, extending the primitive to destruction of an attacker-chosen directory tree and enabling indirect code execution by overwriting files a pipeline later runs. Disabled\", \"certificate verification disabled\"),\r\n \"CWE-502\": (\"Insecure Deserialization\", \"deserialization of untrusted data\"),\r\n \"CWE-798\": (\"Hardcoded Credentials\", \"credentials hardcoded in source\"),\r\n \"CWE-20\": (\"Improper Input Validation\", \"missing input validation\"),\r\n}\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Helpers \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef clean_code(code: str) -> str:\r\n \"\"\"Normalize and truncate code.\"\"\"\r\n if not code:\r\n return \"\"\r\n # Remove null bytes and normalize whitespace\r\n code = code.replace(\"\\x00\", \"\").strip()\r\n # Truncate\r\n if len(code) > MAX_CODE_LENGTH:\r\n code = code[:MAX_CODE_LENGTH] + \"\\n// ... (truncated)\"\r\n return code\r\n\r\n\r\ndef is_valid_code(code: str) -> bool:\r\n \"\"\"Filter out trivially short or empty snippets.\"\"\"\r\n if not code or len(code.strip()) < MIN_CODE_LENGTH:\r\n return False\r\n # Must contain at least one function-like structure\r\n if not re.search(\r\n r\"(def |void |int |char |function |public |private |\\bfn\\b)\",\r\n code, re.IGNORECASE\r\n ):\r\n return False\r\n return True\r\n\r\n\r\ndef cwe_to_finding(cwe_id: str, source: str = \"\") -> dict:\r\n # Normalize CWE format \u2014 some datasets use \"CWE119\" not \"CWE-119\"\r\n if cwe_id and not cwe_id.startswith(\"CWE-\"):\r\n cwe_id = re.sub(r\"CWE(\\d+)\", r\"CWE-\\1\", cwe_id)\r\n meta = CWE_META.get(cwe_id, (\"Unknown Vulnerability\", \"potential security issue\"))\r\n return {\r\n \"category\": meta[0],\r\n \"cwe_ids\": [cwe_id],\r\n \"cwe_id\": cwe_id,\r\n \"affected_code\": meta[1],\r\n \"source\": source,\r\n }\r\n\r\n\r\ndef deduplicate(examples: list) -> list:\r\n \"\"\"Remove exact duplicate code snippets.\"\"\"\r\n seen = set()\r\n result = []\r\n removed = 0\r\n for ex in examples:\r\n # Hash the code to detect duplicates\r\n code_hash = hashlib.md5(\r\n ex[\"instruction\"][:200].encode()\r\n ).hexdigest()\r\n if code_hash not in seen:\r\n seen.add(code_hash)\r\n result.append(ex)\r\n else:\r\n removed += 1\r\n if removed:\r\n print(f\" \ud83e\uddf9 Removed {removed} duplicate examples\")\r\n return result\r\n\r\n\r\ndef make_example(\r\n code: str,\r\n finding: dict,\r\n verdict: str,\r\n reasoning: str,\r\n) -> dict:\r\n prompt = f\"\"\"You are a senior security engineer performing validation review.\r\n\r\nCode:\r\n{code}\r\n\r\nFinding to validate:\r\n{json.dumps(finding, indent=2)}\r\n\r\nDetermine if this finding is:\r\n- CONFIRMED: genuinely present and exploitable in this specific code\r\n- FALSE_POSITIVE: pattern matched but not actually exploitable in context\r\n- NEEDS_CONTEXT: might be vulnerable but requires more context to confirm\r\n\r\nRespond with a JSON object:\r\n{{\"verdict\": \"CONFIRMED|FALSE_POSITIVE|NEEDS_CONTEXT\", \"reasoning\": \"one sentence\"}}\"\"\"\r\n\r\n return {\r\n \"instruction\": prompt,\r\n \"output\": json.dumps({\"verdict\": verdict, \"reasoning\": reasoning}),\r\n \"source\": finding.get(\"source\", \"unknown\"),\r\n \"cwe_id\": finding.get(\"cwe_id\", \"\"),\r\n \"verdict\": verdict,\r\n }\r\n\r\n\r\ndef generate_reasoning(code: str, finding: dict, verdict: str) -> str:\r\n \"\"\"Use LLM to generate natural reasoning string.\"\"\"\r\n import ollama\r\n try:\r\n response = ollama.chat(\r\n model=OLLAMA_LLM,\r\n messages=[{\r\n \"role\": \"user\",\r\n \"content\": (\r\n f\"Given this code and finding, write ONE sentence \"\r\n f\"explaining why the verdict is {verdict}.\\n\\n\"\r\n f\"Code:\\n{code[:400]}\\n\\n\"\r\n f\"Finding: {json.dumps(finding)}\\n\\n\"\r\n f\"Write only the reasoning sentence.\"\r\n )\r\n }],\r\n options={\"temperature\": 0.3},\r\n )\r\n return response[\"message\"][\"content\"].strip()\r\n except Exception:\r\n fallbacks = {\r\n \"CONFIRMED\": f\"{finding.get('affected_code', 'Pattern')} is directly exploitable\",\r\n \"FALSE_POSITIVE\": \"Pattern present but not exploitable in this context\",\r\n \"NEEDS_CONTEXT\": \"Cannot confirm without additional calling context\",\r\n }\r\n return fallbacks.get(verdict, \"\")\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Dataset loaders ]\r\n return [make_example(c, f, v, r) for c, f, v, r in raw]\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Train / val / test split \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef split_dataset(examples: list) -> dict:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n 80% train, 10% validation, 10% test\r\n Stratified by verdict to keep class balance in each split.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n by_verdict = {\"CONFIRMED\": [], \"FALSE_POSITIVE\": [], \"NEEDS_CONTEXT\": []}\r\n for ex in examples:\r\n by_verdict[ex[\"verdict\"]].append(ex)\r\n\r\n train, val, test = [], [], []\r\n\r\n for verdict, items in by_verdict.items():\r\n random.shuffle(items)\r\n n = len(items)\r\n n_val = max(1, int(n * 0.1))\r\n n_test = max(1, int(n * 0.1))\r\n n_train = n - n_val - n_test\r\n\r\n train += items[:n_train]\r\n val += items[n_train:n_train + n_val]\r\n test += items[n_train + n_val:]\r\n\r\n random.shuffle(train)\r\n random.shuffle(val)\r\n random.shuffle(test)\r\n\r\n return {\"train\": [\r\n # strcpy/strcat/gets with a variable argument (not a literal)\r\n (\r\n r\"\\b(strcpy|strcat|gets|sprintf)\\s*\\(\\s*\\w+\\s*,\\s*\\w+\",\r\n \"unbounded string copy \u2014 likely buffer that was just\r\n # returned from a function (common pattern: p = f(); p->x)\r\n (\r\n r\"=\\s*\\w+\\s*\\([^)]*\\)\\s*;[\\s\\S]{0,80}(?:->|\\[\\s*0\\s*\\])\",\r\n \"unchecked return value dereference r\"\\b(system|popen|execl|execv|execlp|execvp)\\s*\\(\\s*(?!\\s*\\\")\",\r\n \"shell execution with variable input \u2014 command injection\",\r\n [\"CWE-78\"],\r\n ),\r\n\r\n # printf/fprintf where the format argument is a variable, not a literal\r\n (\r\n r\"\\b(printf|fprintf|syslog)\\s*\\(\\s*(?:stderr\\s*,\\s*)?\\w+\\s*\\)\",\r\n \"variable as format string \u2014 format string vulnerability\",\r\n [\"CWE-134\"],\r\n ),\r\n\r\n # malloc size involving user input or arithmetic that could wrap\r\n (\r\n r\"malloc\\s*\\([^)]*(?:len|size|count|num|n)\\s*[+*]\",\r\n \"malloc with r\"\\b(memcpy|memmove|memset)\\s*\\([^)]*(?:len|size|count|num|n)\\b\",\r\n \"raw memory op with variable size \u2014 possible out-of-bounds write\",\r\n [\"CWE-119\", \"CWE-787\"],\r\n ),\r\n\r\n # FIX: removed variable-width lookbehind \u2014 not supported in Python re\r\n (\r\n r\"pthread_create|pthread_join\",\r\n \"shared state modified in thread \u2014 possible race condition\",\r\n [\"CWE-362\"],\r\n ),\r\n]\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Lazy-loaded Qdrant client \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n_qdrant_client: Optional[QdrantClient] = None\r\n\r\n\r\ndef get_qdrant_client(host: str = \"localhost\", port: int = 6333) -> QdrantClient:\r\n global _qdrant_client\r\n if _qdrant_client is None:\r\n _qdrant_client = QdrantClient(host=host, port=port)\r\n return _qdrant_client\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Embedding \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef embed_query(text: str) -> list[float]:\r\n \"\"\"Embed a single text string using nomic-embed-text via Ollama.\"\"\"\r\n response = ollama.embed(model=OLLAMA_EMBED, input=text)\r\n return response[\"embeddings\"][0]\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Security context extraction \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef extract_security_context(code: str) -> dict:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Scan code for risky patterns and build an enriched natural-language\r\n query that sits in the same embedding space as stored CVE descriptions.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n found_patterns = []\r\n extra_keywords = []\r\n\r\n for regex, label, cwe_hints in RISKY_PATTERNS:\r\n if re.search(regex, code, re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL):\r\n found_patterns.append({\"label\": label, \"cwe_hints\": cwe_hints})\r\n extra_keywords.append(label)\r\n\r\n # Build enriched query \u2014 natural language so it matches CVE description space\r\n if extra_keywords:\r\n enriched = (\r\n \"This code contains the following security vulnerabilities: \"\r\n + \"; \".join(extra_keywords)\r\n + \". Original code: \"\r\n + code\r\n )\r\n else:\r\n enriched = \"Analyse this code for security vulnerabilities: \" + code\r\n\r\n return {\"patterns\": found_patterns, \"enriched_query\": enriched}\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 LLM Reranking \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef llm_rerank(code: str, candidates: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Ask llama3.2 to score each candidate CVE 0-10 for relevance\r\n to the given code snippet, then re-sort by that score.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n if not candidates:\r\n return candidates\r\n\r\n cve_list = \"\\n\".join([\r\n f\"{i+1}. [{r['cve_id']}] {r['description'][:200]}\"\r\n for i, r in enumerate(candidates)\r\n ])\r\n\r\n prompt = f\"\"\"You are a security expert. Given this code snippet:\r\n{code}\r\nRate each CVE below from 0 to 10 for how directly relevant it is to the\r\nvulnerabilities present in the code. 10 = exact match, 0 = completely unrelated.\r\n\r\nCVEs:\r\n{cve_list}\r\n\r\nRespond ONLY with a JSON array of integers, one score per CVE, in order.\r\nExample: [8, 3, 7, 1, 5]\"\"\"\r\n\r\n try:\r\n response = ollama.chat(\r\n model=OLLAMA_LLM,\r\n messages=[{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": prompt}],\r\n options={\"temperature\": 0},\r\n )\r\n raw = response[\"message\"][\"content\"].strip()\r\n\r\n # Extract JSON array robustly\r\n match = re.search(r\"\\[[\\d,\\s]+\\]\", raw)\r\n if not match:\r\n print(\"\u26a0\ufe0f Reranker returned unexpected format, skipping rerank.\")\r\n return candidates\r\n\r\n scores = json.loads(match.group())\r\n if len(scores) != len(candidates):\r\n print(\"\u26a0\ufe0f Score count mismatch, skipping rerank.\")\r\n return candidates\r\n\r\n # Attach LLM score and re-sort\r\n for i, r in enumerate(candidates):\r\n r[\"llm_score\"] = scores[i]\r\n\r\n reranked = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x[\"llm_score\"], reverse=True)\r\n\r\n # Update ranks after resorting\r\n for i, r in enumerate(reranked):\r\n r[\"rank\"] = i + 1\r\n\r\n return reranked\r\n\r\n except Exception as e:\r\n print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Reranking failed ({e}), returning original order.\")\r\n return candidates\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Main retrieval entry-point \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef retrieve(\r\n code: str,\r\n top_k: int = DEFAULT_TOP_K,\r\n score_threshold: float = 0.55,\r\n severity_filter: Optional[str] = None,\r\n host: str = \"localhost\",\r\n port: int = 6333,\r\n) -> dict:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Main RAG entry-point.\r\n\r\n Args:\r\n code: Source code snippet (any language).\r\n top_k: Number of results to return after reranking.\r\n score_threshold: Minimum cosine similarity to include a result.\r\n severity_filter: If set, only return CVEs with this severity.\r\n host / port: Qdrant connection.\r\n\r\n Returns:\r\n {\r\n \"query_analysis\": { \"patterns\": [...], \"enriched_query\": str },\r\n \"results\": [\r\n {\r\n \"rank\": int,\r\n \"score\": float, # vector similarity\r\n \"llm_score\": int, # 0-10 from reranker, None if rerank failed\r\n \"cve_id\": str,\r\n \"description\": str,\r\n \"severity\": str,\r\n \"cvss_score\": float | None,\r\n \"cwe_ids\": [str],\r\n \"cpe\": [str],\r\n \"published\": str,\r\n }, ...\r\n ]\r\n }\r\n \"\"\"\r\n client = get_qdrant_client(host, port)\r\n\r\n # 1. Analyse code and build enriched query\r\n analysis = extract_security_context(code)\r\n enriched_query = analysis[\"enriched_query\"]\r\n\r\n # 2. Embed enriched query\r\n vector = embed_query(enriched_query)\r\n\r\n # 3. Build optional severity filter\r\n qdrant_filter = None\r\n if severity_filter:\r\n from qdrant_client.models import Filter, FieldCondition, MatchValue\r\n qdrant_filter = Filter(\r\n must=[FieldCondition(\r\n key=\"severity\",\r\n match=MatchValue(value=severity_filter.upper()),\r\n )]\r\n )\r\n\r\n # 4. Search Qdrant \u2014 fetch top_k*2 so reranker has enough candidates\r\n try:\r\n # qdrant-client >= 1.7\r\n response = client.query_points(\r\n collection_name=COLLECTION_NAME,\r\n query=vector,\r\n limit=top_k * 2,\r\n score_threshold=score_threshold,\r\n query_filter=qdrant_filter,\r\n with_payload=True,\r\n )\r\n hits = response.points\r\n except AttributeError:\r\n # fallback for older qdrant-client\r\n hits = client.search(\r\n collection_name=COLLECTION_NAME,\r\n query_vector=vector,\r\n limit=top_k * 2,\r\n score_threshold=score_threshold,\r\n query_filter=qdrant_filter,\r\n with_payload=True,\r\n )\r\n\r\n # 5. Build candidate list from hits\r\n candidates = []\r\n for hit in hits:\r\n p = hit.payload\r\n candidates.append({\r\n \"rank\": len(candidates) + 1,\r\n \"score\": round(hit.score, 4),\r\n \"llm_score\": None,\r\n \"cve_id\": p.get(\"cve_id\", \"N/A\"),\r\n \"description\": p.get(\"description\", \"\"),\r\n \"severity\": p.get(\"severity\", \"UNKNOWN\"),\r\n \"cvss_score\": p.get(\"cvss_score\"),\r\n \"cwe_ids\": p.get(\"cwe_ids\", []),\r\n \"cpe\": p.get(\"cpe\", []),\r\n \"published\": p.get(\"published\", \"\"),\r\n })\r\n\r\n # 6. LLM rerank candidates, then trim to top_k\r\n reranked = llm_rerank(code, candidates)\r\n final = reranked[:top_k]\r\n\r\n return {\"query_analysis\": analysis, \"results\": final}\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Pretty-print helper \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\nSEVERITY_COLOR = {\r\n \"CRITICAL\": \"\\033[91m\", # red\r\n \"HIGH\": \"\\033[93m\", # yellow\r\n \"MEDIUM\": \"\\033[94m\", # blue\r\n \"LOW\": \"\\033[92m\", # green\r\n \"UNKNOWN\": \"\\033[90m\", # grey\r\n}\r\nRESET = \"\\033[0m\"\r\n\r\n\r\ndef format_results(rag_output: dict, color: bool = True) -> str:\r\n analysis = rag_output[\"query_analysis\"]\r\n results = rag_output[\"results\"]\r\n lines = []\r\n\r\n # \u2500\u2500 Detected patterns section \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n if analysis[\"patterns\"]:\r\n lines.append(\"\u250c\u2500 Detected Security Patterns \" + \"\u2500\" * 42)\r\n for p in analysis[\"patterns\"]:\r\n cwe_str = \", \".join(p[\"cwe_hints\"]) or \"\u2014\"\r\n lines.append(f\"\u2502 \u25b8 {p['label']}\")\r\n lines.append(f\"\u2502 CWE hints: {cwe_str}\")\r\n lines.append(\"\u2514\" + \"\u2500\" * 70)\r\n else:\r\n lines.append(\"\u2139 No specific risky patterns detected \u2014 using semantic search only.\")\r\n\r\n lines.append(\"\")\r\n\r\n if not results:\r\n lines.append(\"\u26a0 No relevant CVEs found above the similarity threshold.\")\r\n return \"\\n\".join(lines)\r\n\r\n lines.append(f\"Top {len(results)} Relevant CVEs (vector search + LLM reranked)\")\r\n lines.append(\"\u2550\" * 70)\r\n\r\n for r in results:\r\n sev = r[\"severity\"]\r\n col = SEVERITY_COLOR.get(sev, \"\") if color else \"\"\r\n rst = RESET if color else \"\"\r\n score_bar = \"\u2588\" * int(r[\"score\"] * 20) + \"\u2591\" * (20 - int(r[\"score\"] * 20))\r\n llm_str = f\" LLM score: {r['llm_score']}/10\" if r[\"llm_score\"] is not None else \"\"\r\n\r\n lines.append(f\"\\n#{r['rank']} {col}[{sev}]{rst} {r['cve_id']}{llm_str}\")\r\n lines.append(f\" Vector similarity: {score_bar} {r['score']:.4f}\")\r\n if r[\"cvss_score\"]:\r\n lines.append(f\" CVSS Score: {r['cvss_score']}\")\r\n if r[\"cwe_ids\"]:\r\n lines.append(f\" CWEs: {', '.join(r['cwe_ids'])}\")\r\n lines.append(f\" Published: {r['published']}\")\r\n\r\n # Wrap description at 80 chars\r\n words, line_buf, desc_lines = r[\"description\"].split(), [], []\r\n for w in words:\r\n if sum(len(x) + 1 for x in line_buf) + len(w) > 80:\r\n desc_lines.append(\" \".join(line_buf))\r\n line_buf = [w]\r\n else:\r\n line_buf.append(w)\r\n if line_buf:\r\n desc_lines.append(\" \".join(line_buf))\r\n lines.append(\" Description:\")\r\n for dl in desc_lines:\r\n lines.append(f\" {dl}\")\r\n\r\n if r[\"cpe\"]:\r\n lines.append(f\" Affected: {'; '.join(r['cpe'][:3])}\")\r\n lines.append(\" \" + \"\u2500\" * 66)\r\n\r\n return \"\\n\".join(lines)", "language": "python", "ast_functions": [ { "name": "", "body": "\"\"\"\nRAG retrieval module: given a code snippet, retrieve and rerank\nrelevant CVEs from the Qdrant NVD vector database.\n\nPipeline:\n code snippet\n \u2193 extract_security_context() \u2013 tightened regex, highlight risky patterns\n \u2193 ollama.embed() \u2013 nomic-embed-text 768-dim embedding\n \u2193 Qdrant.search() \u2013 cosine-similarity top-k*2\n \u2193 llm_rerank() \u2013 llama3.2 scores each CVE 0-10\n \u2193 format_results() \u2013 human-readable output\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport json\nfrom typing import Optional\nfrom qdrant_client import QdrantClient\nimport ollama\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Config \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nCOLLECTION_NAME = \"nvd_threats\"\nVECTOR_SIZE = 768\nDEFAULT_TOP_K = 5\nOLLAMA_EMBED = \"nomic-embed-text\"\nOLLAMA_LLM = \"llama3.2\"\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Tightened risky patterns \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nRISKY_PATTERNS = [\n # strcpy/strcat/gets with a variable argument (not a literal)\n (\n r\"\\b(strcpy|strcat|gets|sprintf)\\s*\\(\\s*\\w+\\s*,\\s*\\w+\",\n \"unbounded string copy \u2014 likely buffer overflow\",\n [\"CWE-120\", \"CWE-121\", \"CWE-787\"],\n ),\n\n # free() followed within ~3 lines by a dereference of the same pointer\n (\n r\"free\\s*\\(\\s*(\\w+)\\s*\\)[\\s\\S]{0,120}\\1\\s*(?:->|\\[)\",\n \"free then dereference \u2014 use-after-free\",\n [\"CWE-416\"],\n ),\n\n # double free: two free() calls on the same variable\n (\n r\"free\\s*\\(\\s*(\\w+)\\s*\\)[\\s\\S]{0,200}free\\s*\\(\\s*\\1\\s*\\)\",\n \"double free\",\n [\"CWE-415\"],\n ),\n\n # NULL/nullptr dereference: dereferencing a value that was just\n # returned from a function (common pattern: p = f(); p->x)\n (\n r\"=\\s*\\w+\\s*\\([^)]*\\)\\s*;[\\s\\S]{0,80}(?:->|\\[\\s*0\\s*\\])\",\n \"unchecked return value dereference \u2014 possible null pointer dereference\",\n [\"CWE-476\"],\n ),\n\n # system()/popen()/exec with a non-literal argument\n (\n r\"\\b(system|popen|execl|execv|execlp|execvp)\\s*\\(\\s*(?!\\s*\\\")\",\n \"shell execution with variable input \u2014 command injection\",\n [\"CWE-78\"],\n ),\n\n # printf/fprintf where the format argument is a variable, not a literal\n (\n r\"\\b(printf|fprintf|syslog)\\s*\\(\\s*(?:stderr\\s*,\\s*)?\\w+\\s*\\)\",\n \"variable as format string \u2014 format string vulnerability\",\n [\"CWE-134\"],\n ),\n\n # malloc size involving user input or arithmetic that could wrap\n (\n r\"malloc\\s*\\([^)]*(?:len|size|count|num|n)\\s*[+*]\",\n \"malloc with arithmetic on length \u2014 possible integer overflow/wrap\",\n [\"CWE-190\", \"CWE-122\"],\n ),\n\n # FIX: removed variable-width lookbehind \u2014 not supported in Python re\n (\n r\"pthread_create|pthread_join\",\n \"shared state modified in thread \u2014 possible race condition\",\n [\"CWE-362\"],\n ),\n]\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Lazy-loaded Qdrant client \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\n_qdrant_client: Optional[QdrantClient] = None\n\n\ndef get_qdrant_client(host: str = \"localhost\", port: int = 6333) -> QdrantClient:\n global _qdrant_client\n if _qdrant_client is None:\n _qdrant_client = QdrantClient(host=host, port=port)\n return _qdrant_client\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Embedding \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\ndef embed_query(text: str) -> list[float]:\n \"\"\"Embed a single text string using nomic-embed-text via Ollama.\"\"\"\n response = ollama.embed(model=OLLAMA_EMBED, input=text)\n return response[\"embeddings\"][0]\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Security context extraction \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\ndef extract_security_context(code: str) -> dict:\n \"\"\"\n Scan code for risky patterns and build an enriched natural-language\n query that sits in the same embedding space as stored CVE descriptions.\n \"\"\"\n found_patterns = []\n extra_keywords = []\n\n for regex, label, cwe_hints in RISKY_PATTERNS:\n if re.search(regex, code, re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL):\n found_patterns.append({\"label\": label, \"cwe_hints\": cwe_hints})\n extra_keywords.append(label)\n\n # \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\n_qdrant_client: Optional[QdrantClient] = None\r\n\r\n\r\ndef get_qdrant_client(host: str = \"localhost\", port: int = 6333) -> QdrantClient:\r\n global _qdrant_client\r\n if _qdrant_client is None:\r\n _qdrant_client = QdrantClient(host=host, port=port)\r\n return _qdrant_client\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Embedding \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef embed_query(text: str) -> list[float]:\r\n response = ollama.embed(model=OLLAMA_EMBED, input=text)\r\n return response[\"embeddings\"][0]\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Security context extraction \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef extract_security_context(code: str) -> dict:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Scan code for risky patterns and build an enriched query\r\n mirroring the ingestion text format for symmetric embedding.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n found_patterns = []\r\n extra_keywords = []\r\n all_cwe_hints = []\r\n\r\n for regex, label, cwe_hints in RISKY_PATTERNS:\r\n if re.search(regex, code, re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL):\r\n found_patterns.append({\"label\": label, \"cwe_hints\": cwe_hints})\r\n extra_keywords.append(label)\r\n all_cwe_hints.extend(cwe_hints)\r\n\r\n unique_cwes = list(dict.fromkeys(all_cwe_hints))\r\n\r\n if extra_keywords:\r\n enriched = (\r\n \"Vulnerability: \"\r\n + \"; \".join(extra_keywords)\r\n + (f\" Weakness type: {', '.join(unique_cwes)}.\" if unique_cwes else \"\")\r\n + \" Severity: HIGH.\"\r\n + \" Original code: \"\r\n + code\r\n )\r\n else:\r\n enriched = (\r\n \"Vulnerability: code security analysis. \"\r\n \"Original code: \"\r\n + code\r\n )\r\n\r\n return {\r\n \"patterns\": found_patterns,\r\n \"enriched_query\": enriched,\r\n \"cwe_hints\": unique_cwes,\r\n }\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 LLM Reranking with explanations \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef llm_rerank(code: str, candidates: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Ask llama3.2 to score each CVE 0-10 and explain why it applies,\r\n then re-sort by score.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n if not candidates:\r\n return candidates\r\n\r\n cve_list = \"\\n\".join([\r\n f\"{i+1}. [{r['cve_id']}] \"\r\n f\"[CWEs: {', '.join(r['cwe_ids']) or 'none'}] \"\r\n f\"{r['description']}\"\r\n for i, r in enumerate(candidates)\r\n ])\r\n\r\n prompt = f\"\"\"You are a security expert specializing in code vulnerability analysis.\r\n\r\nGiven this code snippet:\r\n{code}\r\nFor each CVE below rate relevance 0-10 and give one sentence explanation.\r\n\r\nScoring guide:\r\n- 9-10: Same vulnerability class AND same root cause as the code\r\n- 7-8: Same vulnerability class, different context\r\n- 4-6: Related vulnerability category\r\n- 1-3: Loosely related\r\n- 0: Completely unrelated\r\n\r\nCVEs:\r\n{cve_list}\r\n\r\nRespond ONLY with a JSON array, one object per CVE:\r\n[\r\n {{\"score\": 8, \"reason\": \"Direct strcpy buffer overflow match\"}},\r\n {{\"score\": 2, \"reason\": \"Unrelated integer overflow in network stack\"}}\r\n]\"\"\"\r\n\r\n try:\r\n response = ollama.chat(\r\n model=OLLAMA_LLM,\r\n messages=[{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": prompt}],\r\n options={\"temperature\": 0},\r\n )\r\n raw = response[\"message\"][\"content\"].strip()\r\n\r\n match = re.search(r\"\\[[\\s\\S]*\\]\", raw)\r\n if not match:\r\n print(\"\u26a0\ufe0f Reranker returned unexpected format, skipping rerank.\")\r\n for r in candidates:\r\n r[\"llm_score\"] = None\r\n r[\"explanation\"] = \"\"\r\n return candidates\r\n\r\n parsed = json.loads(match.group())\r\n if len(parsed) != len(candidates):\r\n print(\"\u26a0\ufe0f Score count mismatch, skipping rerank.\")\r\n for r in candidates:\r\n r[\"llm_score\"] = None\r\n r[\"explanation\"] = \"\"\r\n return candidates\r\n\r\n for i, r in enumerate(candidates):\r\n r[\"llm_score\"] = parsed[i].get(\"score\", 0)\r\n r[\"explanation\"] = parsed[i].get(\"reason\", \"\")\r\n\r\n reranked = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x[\"llm_score\"], reverse=True)\r\n for i, r in enumerate(reranked):\r\n r[\"rank\"] = i + 1\r\n\r\n return reranked\r\n\r\n except Exception as e:\r\n print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Reranking failed ({e}), returning original order.\")\r\n for r in candidates:\r\n r[\"llm_score\"] = None\r\n r[\"explanation\"] = \"\"\r\n return candidates\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Main retrieval entry-point \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\ndef retrieve(\r\n code: str,\r\n top_k: int = DEFAULT_TOP_K,\r\n score_threshold: float = 0.45,\r\n severity_filter: Optional[str] = None,\r\n host: str = \"localhost\",\r\n port: int = 6333,\r\n) -> RetrievalResult:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Main RAG entry-point. Returns a structured RetrievalResult.\r\n\r\n Args:\r\n code: Source code snippet.\r\n top_k: Number of results after reranking.\r\n score_threshold: Minimum cosine similarity (0.0-1.0).\r\n severity_filter: Optional: CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW\r\n host / port: Qdrant connection.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n client = get_qdrant_client(host, port)\r\n\r\n # 1. Analyse code\r\n analysis = extract_security_context(code)\r\n enriched_query = analysis[\"enriched_query\"]\r\n\r\n # 2. Embed\r\n vector = embed_query(enriched_query)\r\n\r\n # 3. Optional severity filter\r\n qdrant_filter = None\r\n if severity_filter:\r\n from qdrant_client.models import Filter, FieldCondition, MatchValue\r\n qdrant_filter = Filter(\r\n must=[FieldCondition(\r\n key=\"severity\",\r\n match=MatchValue(value=severity_filter.upper()),\r\n )]\r\n )\r\n\r\n # 4. Search Qdrant\r\n try:\r\n response = client.query_points(\r\n collection_name=COLLECTION_NAME,\r\n query=vector,\r\n limit=top_k * 4,\r\n score_threshold=score_threshold,\r\n query_filter=qdrant_filter,\r\n with_payload=True,\r\n )\r\n hits = response.points\r\n except AttributeError:\r\n hits = client.search(\r\n collection_name=COLLECTION_NAME,\r\n query_vector=vector,\r\n limit=top_k * 4,\r\n score_threshold=score_threshold,\r\n query_filter=qdrant_filter,\r\n with_payload=True,\r\n )\r\n\r\n # 5. Build candidates\r\n candidates = []\r\n for hit in hits:\r\n p = hit.payload\r\n candidates.append({\r\n \"rank\": len(candidates) + 1,\r\n \"score\": round(hit.score, 4),\r\n \"llm_score\": None,\r\n \"explanation\": \"\",\r\n \"cve_id\": p.get(\"cve_id\", \"N/A\"),\r\n \"description\": p.get(\"description\", \"\"),\r\n \"severity\": p.get(\"severity\", \"UNKNOWN\"),\r\n \"cvss_score\": p.get(\"cvss_score\"),\r\n \"cwe_ids\": p.get(\"cwe_ids\", []),\r\n \"cpe\": p.get(\"cpe\", []),\r\n \"published\": p.get(\"published\", \"\"),\r\n })\r\n\r\n # 6. Rerank and trim\r\n reranked = llm_rerank(code, candidates)\r\n final = reranked[:top_k]\r\n\r\n # 7. Build structured result\r\n top = final[0] if final else None\r\n sev = highest_severity(final)\r\n\r\n if not final:\r\n summary = \"No relevant CVEs found above similarity threshold.\"\r\n elif sev == \"CRITICAL\":\r\n summary = (\r\n f\"CRITICAL risk: {len(final)} CVEs matched, \"\r\n f\"top match {top['cve_id']} \"\r\n f\"(LLM score: {top['llm_score']}/10). \"\r\n f\"Immediate remediation recommended.\"\r\n )\r\n elif sev == \"HIGH\":\r\n summary = (\r\n f\"HIGH risk: {len(final)} CVEs matched, \"\r\n f\"top match {top['cve_id']} \"\r\n f\"(LLM score: {top['llm_score']}/10). \"\r\n f\"Review and patch recommended.\"\r\n )\r\n else:\r\n summary = (\r\n f\"{sev} risk: {len(final)} CVEs matched, \"\r\n f\"top match {top['cve_id']}.\"\r\n )\r\n\r\n return RetrievalResult(\r\n code_snippet = code,\r\n patterns_detected = analysis[\"patterns\"],\r\n cwe_hints = analysis[\"cwe_hints\"],\r\n cve_matches = [CVEMatch(\r\n rank = r[\"rank\"],\r\n cve_id = r[\"cve_id\"],\r\n severity = r[\"severity\"],\r\n cvss_score = r[\"cvss_score\"],\r\n vector_score = r[\"score\"],\r\n llm_score = r[\"llm_score\"],\r\n explanation = r[\"explanation\"],\r\n cwe_ids = r[\"cwe_ids\"],\r\n cpe = r[\"cpe\"],\r\n description = r[\"description\"],\r\n published = r[\"published\"],\r\n ).to_dict() for r in final],\r\n total_candidates_found = len(candidates),\r\n highest_severity = sev,\r\n top_cve_id = top[\"cve_id\"] if top else \"N/A\",\r\n top_cve_description = top[\"description\"] if top else \"\",\r\n top_llm_score = top[\"llm_score\"] if top else None,\r\n risk_summary = summary,\r\n enriched_query = enriched_query,\r\n score_threshold_used = score_threshold,\r\n )\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Async wrapper \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\nasync def retrieve_async(\r\n code: str,\r\n top_k: int = DEFAULT_TOP_K,\r\n score_threshold: float = 0.45,\r\n severity_filter: Optional[str] = None,\r\n) -> RetrievalResult:\r\n \"\"\"Async wrapper for use in async frameworks or FastAPI.\"\"\"\r\n loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()\r\n return await loop.run_in_executor(\r\n None,\r\n lambda: retrieve(code, top_k, score_threshold, severity_filter)\r\n )\r\n\r\n\r\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Pretty-print \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\r\nSEVERITY_COLOR = {\r\n \"CRITICAL\": \"\\033[91m\",\r\n \"HIGH\": \"\\033[93m\",\r\n \"MEDIUM\": \"\\033[94m\",\r\n \"LOW\": \"\\033[92m\",\r\n \"UNKNOWN\": \"\\033[90m\",\r\n}\r\nRESET = \"\\033[0m\"\r\n\r\n\r\ndef format_results(rag_output, color: bool = True) -> str:\r\n \"\"\"\r\n Accepts RetrievalResult dataclass or legacy dict.\r\n Renders human-readable terminal output.\r\n \"\"\"\r\n if isinstance(rag_output, RetrievalResult):\r\n patterns = rag_output.patterns_detected\r\n results = rag_output.cve_matches\r\n summary = rag_output.risk_summary\r\n else:\r\n patterns = rag_output[\"query_analysis\"][\"patterns\"]\r\n results = rag_output[\"results\"]\r\n summary = \"\"\r\n\r\n lines = []\r\n\r\n if patterns:\r\n lines.append(\"\u250c\u2500 Detected Security Patterns \" + \"\u2500\" * 42)\r\n for p in patterns:\r\n cwe_str = \", \".join(p[\"cwe_hints\"]) or \"\u2014\"\r\n lines.append(f\"\u2502 \u25b8 {p['label']}\")\r\n lines.append(f\"\u2502 CWE hints: {cwe_str}\")\r\n lines.append(\"\u2514\" + \"\u2500\" * 70)\r\n else:\r\n lines.append(\"\u2139 No specific risky patterns detected \u2014 using semantic search only.\")\r\n\r\n if summary:\r\n lines.append(f\"\\n\u26a1 Risk Summary: {summary}\")\r\n\r\n lines.append(\"\")\r\n\r\n if not results:\r\n lines.append(\"\u26a0 No relevant CVEs found above the similarity threshold.\")\r\n lines.append(\" Try lowering score_threshold or check Qdrant has data:\")\r\n lines.append(\" curl http://localhost:6333/collections/nvd_threats\")\r\n return \"\\n\".join(lines)\r\n\r\n lines.append(f\"Top {len(results)} Relevant CVEs (vector search + LLM reranked)\")\r\n lines.append(\"\u2550\" * 70)\r\n\r\n for r in results:\r\n sev = r[\"severity\"]\r\n col = SEVERITY_COLOR.get(sev, \"\") if color else \"\"\r\n rst = RESET if color else \"\"\r\n score_bar = \"\u2588\" * int(r[\"vector_score\"] * 20) + \"\u2591\" * (20 - int(r[\"vector_score\"] * 20))\r\n llm_str = f\" LLM score: {r['llm_score']}/10\" if r[\"llm_score\"] is not None else \"\"\r\n\r\n lines.append(f\"\\n#{r['rank']} {col}[{sev}]{rst} {r['cve_id']}{llm_str}\")\r\n lines.append(f\" Vector similarity: {score_bar} {r['vector_score']:.4f}\")\r\n if r[\"cvss_score\"]:\r\n lines.append(f\" CVSS Score: {r['cvss_score']}\")\r\n if r[\"cwe_ids\"]:\r\n lines.append(f\" CWEs: {', '.join(r['cwe_ids'])}\")\r\n lines.append(f\" Published: {r['published']}\")\r\n if r.get(\"explanation\"):\r\n lines.append(f\" Why relevant: {r['explanation']}\")\r\n\r\n words, line_buf, desc_lines all_cwe_hints = []\n\n for regex, label, cwe_hints in RISKY_PATTERNS:\n if re.search(regex, code, re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL):\n found_patterns.append({\"label\": label, \"cwe_hints\": cwe_hints})\n \"Vulnerability: code security analysis. \"\n \"Original code: \"\n + code\n )\n\n return {\n \"patterns\": found_patterns,\n \"enriched_query\": enriched,\n \"cwe_hints\": unique_cwes,\n }\n\n\n# llm_rerank(code: str, candidates: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:\n \"\"\"\n Ask llama3.2 to score each CVE 0-10 and explain why it applies,\n then re-sort by score.\n \"\"\"\n if not candidates:\n return [{r['cve_id']}] \"\n f\"[CWEs: {', '.join(r['cwe_ids']) or 'none'}] \"\n f\"{r['description']}\"\n for i, r in enumerate(candidates)\n ])\n\n prompt = f\"\"\"You are a security expert specializing in code vulnerability analysis.\n\nGiven this code snippet:\n{code}\nFor each CVE below rate relevance 0-10 and give one sentence explanation.\n\nScoring guide:\n- 9-10: Same vulnerability class AND same root cause as the code\n- 7-8: Same vulnerability class, different context\n- 4-6: Related vulnerability category\n- 1-3: Loosely related\n- 0: Completely unrelated\n\nCVEs:\n{cve_list}\n\nRespond ONLY with a JSON array, one object per CVE:\n[\n {{\"score\": 8, \"reason\": \"Direct strcpy buffer overflow match\"}},\n {{\"score\": 2, \"reason\": \"Unrelated integer overflow in network stack\"}}\n]\"\"\"\n\n try:\n response = ollama.chat(\n model=OLLAMA_LLM,\n messages=[{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": prompt}],\n options={\"temperature\": 0},\n )\n raw = response[\"message\"][\"content\"].strip()\n\n match = re.search(r\"\\[[\\s\\S]*\\]\", raw)\n if not match:\n print(\"\u26a0\ufe0f Reranker returned unexpected format, skipping rerank.\")\n for r in candidates:\n r[\"llm_score\"] = None\n r[\"explanation\"] = \"\"\n return candidates\n\n parsed = json.loads(match.group())\n if len(parsed) != len(candidates):\n print(\"\u26a0\ufe0f Score count mismatch, skipping rerank.\")\n for r in candidates:\n r[\"llm_score\"] = None\n r[\"explanation\"] = \"\"\n return candidates\n\n for i, r in enumerate(candidates):\n r[\"llm_score\"] = parsed[i].get(\"score\", 0)\n r[\"explanation\"] = parsed[i].get(\"reason\", \"\")\n\n reranked = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x[\"llm_score\"], reverse=True)\n for i, r in enumerate(reranked):\n r[\"rank\"] = i + 1\n\n return reranked\n\n except Exception as e:\n print(f\"\u26a0\ufe0f Reranking failed ({e}), returning original order.\")\n for r in candidates:\n r[\"llm_score\"] = None\n r[\"explanation\"] = \"\"\n return candidates\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Main retrieval entry-point \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\ndef retrieve(\n code: str,\n top_k: int = DEFAULT_TOP_K,\n score_threshold: float = 0.45,\n severity_filter: Optional[str] = None,\n host: str = \"localhost\",\n port: int = 6333,\n) -> RetrievalResult:\n \"\"\"\n Main RAG entry-point. Returns a structured RetrievalResult.\n\n Args:\n code: Source code snippet.\n top_k: Number of results after reranking.\n score_threshold: Minimum cosine similarity (0.0-1.0).\n severity_filter: Optional: CRITICAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW\n host / port: Qdrant connection.\n \"\"\"\n client = get_qdrant_client(host, port)\n\n # 1. Analyse code\n analysis = extract_security_context(code)\n enriched_query = analysis[\"enriched_query\"]\n\n # 2. Embed\n vector = embed_query(enriched_query)\n\n # 3. Optional severity filter\n qdrant_filter = None\n if severity_filter:\n from qdrant_client.models import Filter, FieldCondition, MatchValue\n qdrant_filter = Filter(\n must=[FieldCondition(\n key=\"severity\",\n match=MatchValue(value=severity_filter.upper()),\n )]\n )\n\n # 4. Search Qdrant\n try:\n response = client.query_points(\n collection_name=COLLECTION_NAME,\n query=vector,\n limit=top_k * 4,\n score_threshold=score_threshold,\n query_filter=qdrant_filter,\n with_payload=True,\n )\n hits = response.points\n except AttributeError:\n hits = client.search(\n collection_name=COLLECTION_NAME,\n query_vector=vector,\n limit=top_k * 4,\n score_threshold=score_threshold,\n query_filter=qdrant_filter,\n with_payload=True,\n )\n\n # 5. Build candidates\n candidates = []\n for hit in hits:\n p = hit.payload\n candidates.append({\n \"rank\": len(candidates) + 1,\n \"score\": round(hit.score, 4),\n \"llm_score\": None,\n \"explanation\": \"\",\n \"cve_id\": p.get(\"cve_id\", \"N/A\"),\n \"description\": p.get(\"description\", \"\"),\n \"severity\": p.get(\"severity\", \"UNKNOWN\"),\n \"cvss_score\": p.get(\"cvss_score\"),\n \"cwe_ids\": p.get(\"cwe_ids\", []),\n \"cpe\": p.get(\"cpe\", []),\n \"published\": p.get(\"published\", \"\"),\n })\n\n # 6. Rerank and trim\n reranked = llm_rerank(code, candidates)\n final = reranked[:top_k]\n\n # 7. Build structured result\n top = final[0] if final else None\n sev = highest_severity(final)\n\n if not final:\n summary = \"No relevant CVEs found above similarity threshold.\"\n elif sev == \"CRITICAL\":\n summary = (\n f\"CRITICAL risk: {len(final)} CVEs matched, \"\n f\"top match {top['cve_id']} \"\n f\"(LLM score: {top['llm_score']}/10). \"\n f\"Immediate remediation recommended.\"\n )\n elif sev == \"HIGH\":\n summary = (\n f\"HIGH risk: {len(final)} CVEs matched, \"\n f\"top match {top['cve_id']} \"\n f\"(LLM score: {top['llm_score']}/10). \"\n f\"Review and patch recommended.\"\n )\n else:\n summary = (\n f\"{sev} risk: {len(final)} CVEs matched, \"\n f\"top match {top['cve_id']}.\"\n )\n\n return RetrievalResult(\n code_snippet = code,\n patterns_detected = analysis[\"patterns\"],\n cwe_hints = analysis[\"cwe_hints\"],\n cve_matches = [CVEMatch(\n rank = r[\"rank\"],\n cve_id = r[\"cve_id\"],\n severity = r[\"severity\"],\n cvss_score = r[\"cvss_score\"],\n vector_score = r[\"score\"],\n llm_score = r[\"llm_score\"],\n explanation = r[\"explanation\"],\n cwe_ids = r[\"cwe_ids\"],\n cpe = r[\"cpe\"],\n description = r[\"description\"],\n published = r[\"published\"],\n ).to_dict() for r in final],\n total_candidates_found = len(candidates),\n highest_severity = sev,\n top_cve_id = top[\"cve_id\"] if top else \"N/A\",\n top_cve_description = top[\"description\"] if top else \"\",\n top_llm_score = top[\"llm_score\"] if top else None,\n risk_summary = summary,\n enriched_query = enriched_query,\n score_threshold_used = score_threshold,\n )\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Async wrapper \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nasync def retrieve_async(\n code: str,\n top_k: int = DEFAULT_TOP_K,\n score_threshold: float = 0.45,\n severity_filter: Optional[str] = None,\n) -> RetrievalResult:\n \"\"\"Async wrapper for use in async frameworks or FastAPI.\"\"\"\n loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()\n return await loop.run_in_executor(\n None,\n lambda: retrieve(code, top_k, score_threshold, severity_filter)\n )\n\n\n# \u2500\u2500\u2500 Pretty-print \u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\nSEVERITY_COLOR = {\n \"CRITICAL\": \"\\033[91m\",\n \"HIGH\": \"\\033[93m\",\n \"MEDIUM\": \"\\033[94m\",\n \"LOW\": \"\\033[92m\",\n \"UNKNOWN\": \"\\033[90m\",\n}\nRESET = \"\\033[0m\"\n\n\ndef format_results(rag_output, color: bool = True) -> str:\n \"\"\"\n Accepts RetrievalResult dataclass or legacy dict.\n Renders human-readable terminal output.\n \"\"\"\n if isinstance(rag_output, A path composed with that operator discards the left operand when the right one is absolute and follows parent references otherwise, so a filename such as ../../../tmp/x or /tmp/x resolves outside the intended directory; nothing canonicalises the result, checks that it remains under the upload root, or prevents a .py suffix. The route's only dependency is get_user_from_headers in dbgpt_serve/utils/auth.py, which returns a request carrying the admin role whether or not a user_id header is supplied, so the endpoint is reachable without credentials. packages/dbgpt-app/src/dbgpt_app/openapi/api_v1/agentic_data_api.py takes file.filename as given and writes the request body to upload_dir / filename. A path composed with that operator discards the left operand when the right one is absolute and follows parent references otherwise, so a filename such as ../../../tmp/x or /tmp/x resolves outside the intended directory; nothing canonicalises the result, checks that it remains under the upload root, or prevents a .py suffix. The route's only dependency is get_user_from_headers in dbgpt_serve/utils/auth.py, which returns a request carrying the admin role whether or not a user_id header is supplied, so the endpoint is reachable without credentials.
